SELECT ws.stock_no AS stockNo, ws.qty AS qty, ws.received_at AS receivedAt, ws.status AS status,
mg.material_group_id AS materialGroupId, mg.group_name AS groupName,
m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.unit AS unit, m.material_price AS materialPrice, m.price AS price
FROM warehouse_stock ws JOIN material m ON ws.material_code = m.material_code
JOIN material_group mg ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id
AND mg.group_name = #{groupName}
AND m.material_name = #{materialName}
AND ( ws.stock_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR mg.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY ws.received_at DESC
SELECT mg.group_name, m.material_name FROM material_group mg JOIN material m ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id ORDER BY mg.material_group_id, m.material_name;
